fact: The article says Burundi's national AI strategy 2025-2030 was validated in April 2026 with UNDP support, and that it has still to move from the national framework to first applications; it records validation, not approval or launch by the government.

The article reports that Burundi is adopting a national AI strategy for 2025-2030, designed by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy with UNDP, following its validation in Bujumbura on 22 April 2026.

The state news agency reports that the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy with UNDP opened a validation session for the national AI strategy on 21 April 2026, to validate the country's strategic orientations; it does not report approval or launch.
UNDP reports that a national AI landscape assessment workshop held 25-27 November 2025 in Bujumbura fed the future National AI Strategy, which the government says it will now draw up.

Digital Business Africa, citing UNDP Burundi, reports the national AI strategy was validated on 21-22 April 2026 by UNDP and Finance, Budget and Digital Economy Ministry representatives over two days of discussion; no cabinet approval or launch is stated.
